question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who draws or produces maps
solution: The correct answer is: **Cartographer** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **cartographer **is a person who draws or produces maps. (मानचित्रकार वह व्यक्ति होता है जो मानचित्र बनाता या बनाता है) • **For example**: *The cartographer created detailed maps of uncharted lands.* • The word is derived from the Greek word "chartes" meaning map and "graphein" meaning to write. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Calligrapher**: A person who practices the art of beautiful handwriting. (एक व्यक्ति जो सुंदर लिखावट की कला का अभ्यास करता है) • **Choreographer**: A person who creates and arranges dances for stage performances. (एक व्यक्ति जो मंच प्रदर्शन के लिए नृत्य बनाता और व्यवस्थित करता है) • **Chauffeur**: A person employed to drive a private or hired car for someone else. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी अन्य के लिए निजी या किराए की कार चलाने के लिए नियोजित है) 36:T892, The correct answer is: "**house were dashed when**"
